objective: A mapping and live-camera rover built from a faulty Xiaomi Mi robot vacuum (1st gen) and a cracked Android phone: maps a room with the vacuum's laser scanner, drives on its own wheels and battery, streams video on the local network; cheaper than a new pet camera robot.

research.summary: 8 of HS's own records, 0 GitHub projects, 0 BoardRepo boards, 0 GitHub KiCad files (0 with a reusable licence)

decisions.title: keep the vacuum body
decisions.choice: Keep the vacuum's own chassis, wheels, laser scanner, pack, bumper and cliff sensors in place; replace only what is dead
decisions.because: The body already holds every module at the right height and the scanned STEP models are too coarse to place mounting holes on a new chassis

decisions.title: route by what the donor's main board does
decisions.choice: Route A: board works -> Valetudo (local control and map) plus the phone as camera. Route B: board dead -> ESP32-S3 with two DRV8871 for the wheels and a MOSFET for the scanner motor
decisions.because: Route A needs no new electronics; route B uses the measured wheel module pinout and kaiaai/LDS, which needs an external motor driver for the LDS02RR

software_checked.summary: 25 of 40 gearmotor options pass; best pololu-25d-mp-12v 99:1
US$46.83 for 10 lines against US$50.00; 2 salvaged, US$10.39 new

physical_required.boundary: Linear DC-motor model between the maker's no-load and (extrapolated) stall points at nominal voltage; Pololu says units stall well before the listed point as they heat. No battery sag, wheel slip or turning losses.

Sizing calculation from stated loads and ratings. Nothing was built or measured. Runtime and surge must be tested with the real loads, and AC wiring, residual current protection and earthing need a qualified electrician.
Shop prices on the day they were read; shipping, tax and stock change. A salvaged part is assumed to work until the donor is opened and the part is tested.

authority: software checks only; no fabrication, power-on, flight or release is authorised by this record
